title: Harmony - First Meeting

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Don’t be fooled by its size, this PRU is packing some pretty hefty deals!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don’t be fooled by its size, this PRU is packing some pretty hefty deals!

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: My Personal Retail Unit! Everything you could possibly need all inside one handy, gyro-stabilized mobile body-mounted mini-mart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My Personal Retail Unit! Everything you could possibly need all inside one handy, gyro-stabilized mobile body-mounted mini-mart.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I mean when you put it like that... That is exactly what it is!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean when you put it like that... That is exactly what it is!

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: You get used to it. No way I could afford static real estate in this city, so it's either this or a lifetime in a Curzona giga-factory. No thank you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You get used to it. No way I could afford static real estate in this city, so it's either this or a lifetime in a Curzona giga-factory. No thank you!

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Look, I don't want to sound callous here, but this whole serial killer, CorpSec, Unity Zone mess has been great for me. You know, economically.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I don't want to sound callous here, but this whole serial killer, CorpSec, Unity Zone mess has been great for me. You know, economically.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I mean, half of my competitors are stuck outside the Zone. I practically have Lowtown to myself!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, half of my competitors are stuck outside the Zone. I practically have Lowtown to myself!

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Hmmm, you're right. I know you're right. God, I'm so selfish aren't I? It's just that... Well times were pretty hard here even before this Aseptic stuff started.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm, you're right. I know you're right. God, I'm so selfish aren't I? It's just that... Well times were pretty hard here even before this Aseptic stuff started.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Well your optics must be tinted differently my friend. You'll have to tell me where you got them!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well your optics must be tinted differently my friend. You'll have to tell me where you got them!

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: It sure can! But there is a beauty here too, somewhere between mold and mildew, I've seen it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sure can! But there is a beauty here too, somewhere between mold and mildew, I've seen it.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: It's just, spending so much time under this much cloud can make it hard to see the silver lining sometimes. Know what I mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's just, spending so much time under this much cloud can make it hard to see the silver lining sometimes. Know what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, PRU?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, PRU?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So it's basically a backpack shop?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it's basically a backpack shop?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So it's basically a backpack shop?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So it's basically a backpack shop?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It looks heavy!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It looks heavy!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's business?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's business?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How so?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That seems like a pretty messed up way of looking at it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That seems like a pretty messed up way of looking at it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That seems like a pretty messed up way of looking at it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That seems like a pretty messed up way of looking at it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems like a high price to pay...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems like a high price to pay...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seems like a high price to pay...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seems like a high price to pay...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not really, I like it here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really, I like it here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not really, I like it here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not really, I like it here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess Nivalis can be tough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess Nivalis can be tough.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess Nivalis can be tough.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess Nivalis can be tough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have a nice day!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have a nice day!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you say so. Bye for now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you say so. Bye for now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you say so. Bye for now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you say so. Bye for now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like the idea of that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like the idea of that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like the idea of that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like the idea of that.
